label: scope4-cap-hardening-accepts
description: Authored Scope 4 cap case: at the round cap the convertible set is class-based (every open hardening finding converts regardless of first-occurrence), so a re-litigated-but-not-reopened hardening point converts instead of failing the run. roundLimit is 4 (default threshold 3). Round 3 banks a first-occurrence hardening finding (C3) on arrival while a co-occurring plan-correctness finding (C4) forces the round. Round 4 (== the cap) re-raises C3 as a SECOND occurrence: pre-cap a repeat occurrence forces a revision round, but at the cap it converts to debt and the review lands accepted-with-debt. C3 spans only rounds 3-4 (two rounds) so the >=3-round reopen convergence block does not fire.
